review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.notes: Reviewed real handler validation and independent fake routes, current React renderer mocks, sequential Android dependencies and browser lifecycle. Synthetic loopback only; retain original 31 UI checks and complete selected suites. No native/device acceptance inferred from component tests; no release/install/account changes. Measure same source/cases/environment before speed claims. CI narrowing requires proof that production cannot import affected tests.
